purpose.zh: 单手接住体重，练肩部稳定
purpose.en: Build shoulder stability as one hand takes your weight.

text.zh: 承重手推地，触肩时骨盆不晃
text.en: Push the floor with the support hand and keep your hips still as you tap
Hold a high plank with your feet a little apart.

text.zh: 承重手肘锁直，肩不往下塌
text.en: Keep the support arm straight and do not let the shoulder sink.

commonErrors.zh: 触得太快，身体左右摇晃
commonErrors.en: Tapping too fast so the body rocks side to side.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
